title: Reformulating the Other Side's Argument
goal: Paraphrase an opponent's claims with formal reformulation markers and shift time and place deictics when reporting past statements.
grammar: reformulation markers (es decir, en otras palabras) and deictic shifts in reported speech

items: I can paraphrase or sharpen a claim in debate using *es decir* and *en otras palabras*.
I can shift time and place deictics (*aquí → allí*, *hoy → aquel día*) when reporting past debate statements.
I can use terms for distorting words, reasoning, sticking to or deflecting from a topic, and panellists.
